previousSlugs.description: Former slugs after a rename (0.9.1+; rename-bot skill). Optional.

status.description: pre-fleet = listed during bootstrap phase 1 (platform prompt only); converting = phase-2 conversion in progress (0.8.0+)

prompt_mode.description: 0.12.0. Overrides the fleet prompt_mode for this bot.

capabilities.description: 0.12.0. Optional capability tags. A prompt source with applies_to.capabilities is included only when one of these matches.

owner_name.description: Owner's display name; fills {{OWNER_NAME}} in THIN-PROMPT.tmpl (0.8.0+). Optional.

prompt_mode.description: 0.12.0. files (default when omitted) keeps the thin prompt. compiled embeds the pre-action routine and that bot's action index. A bot prompt_mode overrides this.

prompt_max_chars.description: 0.12.0. Optional fleet-wide compiled-prompt character cap. Absent means 8000. An integer from 8000 through 12000. BOT_FLEET_PROMPT_MAX overrides it. A bot.json prompt_cap overrides both. The floor is 8000 whatever this value is.

board.description: 0.12.0 optional shared task board. Omit the key to leave the feature off. coordinator is a bot slug, not a role.

path.description: Repo-relative markdown file. schema_check.py also requires the coordinator slug to be a non-retired bot.

coordinator.description: Bot slug that scans the board. Not a role name.
